verses.1: To be buried on Shushan, according to David’s command.
verses.2: In his conquest of the land of Canaan and the land of Zobah, Joshua settled Adam in the valley of Ainnai. This happened two hundred years after their departure from Egypt.
verses.3: God has abandoned us; you have scattered us. May you be cursed!
verses.4: The earth shook, its foundations were broken apart, because of his anger.
verses.5: You saw that it was difficult for your people; so you caused them to suffer great hardships.
verses.6: You have given your children a chance to experience what it’s like to face difficulties.
verses.7: That your friends may be rescued, that Your Hand may save them, and that You may answer me.
verses.8: God’s words are holy. I will elevate them, and they will be pure and clear.
verses.9: To me, Gilad and Menashe, and to Ephraim, may the heads of Judah be blessed.
verses.10: May the Lord destroy those who harm people. May I put my shoes on over my feet. I am lost in confusion.
verses.11: Who will save me from this city of chaos? Who will take me to Edom?
verses.12: You are not God; you have abandoned us. And let no God emerge from our midst.
verses.13: May we receive help from Egypt, and may there be a way out for us.
verses.14: May God create a way out of this situation, and may He save us from our troubles.
